title: Welcome to the Data Visualization Section!

cues.en: Now that we've finished learning about our data analysis libraries it's time to actually start visualizing that data.
cues.zh: 資料分析函式庫已經學完，現在開始把資料視覺化。

cues.en: We'll start off by learning about MAP plot live then we'll move on to seaborne for statistical plots .
cues.zh: 先學 matplotlib，再用 seaborn 畫統計圖。

cues.en: Afterwards we'll learn about pandas built in data visualization capabilities and then we'll see how to use plot to create awesome interactive plots with just a few lines of Python code.
cues.zh: 之後學 pandas 內建視覺化，接著用 Plotly，只寫幾行 Python，就能建立很棒的互動圖表。

cues.en: Thank you so much and I'll see you at the next lecture.
